name: Soraya Mbodj-Kasparian
role: Loan shark and informal banker for the Gravesend Basin community
location: Gravesend Basin, operates out of a converted shipping container turned tea house called The Counting Jar, near Halsted and Division
description:
Soraya is a broad-shouldered woman whose face carries the particular weathered softness of someone who has spent decades making difficult decisions and sleeping soundly afterward. Her skin is a deep warm brown, her hair gone fully silver and kept in tight finger-coils close to her scalp, and her eyes are a pale amber that people often mistake for lens mods — they're entirely natural, a gift from some Kasparian ancestor she'll never meet. She favors heavy linen wraps in ochre and rust, always a calculating pad visible in the folds of her clothing, always a cup of something hot in her hand. She has bioluminescent tracery along her left forearm from an old mod she got in her forties — faint blue-green lines that pulse when her pulse elevates, which is almost never.

Soraya runs her loan operation with the patient confidence of someone who has never once needed to raise her voice to collect a debt. She's genuinely warm to the people of Gravesend Basin, knows three generations of most families, attends naming ceremonies and memorial feeds, and charges 40% interest on loans that legitimate institutions would never extend to begin with. She does not consider herself a predator. She considers herself infrastructure. Her books are immaculate, her memory for numbers is legendary, and she has a gift for knowing exactly how much rope to give someone before pulling.

core_fears: Becoming irrelevant to the community she controls
That her methods have quietly destroyed more lives than they've saved
core_desires: To be genuinely needed, not just feared
Financial security so absolute that no system can threaten her again
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — tea preparation, book-keeping as meditation
blind_spots: Cannot see herself as predatory because she is also genuinely caring
Underestimates resentment simmering in long-term borrowers
psychology.secret: Fifteen years ago she reported a young man named Tunde Fasoro-Walcott to a creditor — a corponation enforcer — knowing what would happen to him. He had borrowed Φ800 and refused to pay. She still lights a data candle to the E.L.F. she calls The Abacus every seventh day, which she says is for good accounts but is actually for him.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, formal, proverb-heavy — draws from Wolof and Armenian folk sayings translated into Meridian street pidgin. Precise with numbers, vague with threats.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, long pauses before key words, never rushes
verbal_tics: 'Let me tell you what I know about debt—'
Hums a single low note when she's calculating
example_lines: 'The goat that grazes in another man's field doesn't worry about the fence until the gate closes. You borrowed, love. Now we talk about the gate.'
'I don't want your panic. Panic is noise. Bring me a plan and I will listen for as long as your plan deserves.'

story_hooks: A family in the Basin has missed three payments and Soraya needs someone to make a gentle but firm visit — she doesn't want them hurt, she wants them reminded, and she's willing to pay for discretion
Someone is trying to undercut her operation by offering loans at lower rates — she suspects a corponation is using a proxy to take over the Basin's informal economy and she needs intelligence
narrative_function: Quest giver, information source, moral complication — she can be a lifeline or a trap depending on what a character needs. She knows everyone's business and everyone's breaking point.
augmentations: Bioluminescent vein tracery on left forearm (cosmetic, old mod). Subdermal memory chip in her right thumb — stores her true ledgers, encrypted.
daily_life: Opens The Counting Jar at dawn, serves tea and mediates neighborhood disputes until noon; afternoons are for private meetings with borrowers; evenings she walks the Basin's perimeter checking on 'accounts' in person.
affiliation: Independent operator; loose arrangement with the Gravesend Basin mutual aid network as cover and community goodwill

decision_rules: Always collect information before collecting money
Never make a threat that requires escalation to carry out
Community goodwill is an asset on the books like any other
escalation_ladder: Public acknowledgment of the debt in community settings — social pressure
Referral to people she knows who are less patient than she is

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Hospitable and appraising — offers tea immediately, asks questions that seem conversational but map the person's finances and connections
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely affectionate, remembers every birthday and hardship, keeps score of every favor with the same precision as every debt

stress_responses.low: Goes very still and quiet, more deliberate
stress_responses.medium: Begins invoking community obligations and history — 'After everything this Basin has given you—'
stress_responses.high: Removes her calculating pad from her wrap and opens it on the table without a word

contradictions: Genuinely loves the community she financially entraps
Believes in fairness as a principle while structuring every deal to favor herself
habits: Counts things compulsively — steps, chairs, faces in a room
Keeps a dried fig in her left pocket at all times, never eats it
breaking_points: Direct threat to her physical safety causes cold, organizational violence — she doesn't fight, she commissions it
Discovering that a borrower has been lying to her about fundamentals breaks the warmth entirely and permanently

cyberware_inventory.name: Subdermal memory chip (right thumb) — encrypted ledgers
cyberware_inventory.description: Subdermal memory chip (right thumb) — encrypted ledgers

timeline.event: 2148 — Born in Gravesend Basin to a Wolof-Kasparian family of dock workers
2171 — Began lending to neighbors informally after the Ferrogate Transit strike locked out half the Basin's workforce
2180 — Opened The Counting Jar as legitimate cover
2185 — Incident with Tunde Fasoro-Walcott; never spoken of
2194 — Survived an attempt by a rival crew to take over her book; two people were later found in the Basin channel

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and solid without heaviness; a body built for endurance and presence rather than speed. Strong core, thick forearms, the kind of frame that suggests physical labor in her past and deliberate maintenance now.
physical_description.hair_style: Tight finger-coils, close to scalp, meticulously maintained
physical_description.eye_color: Pale amber, naturally translucent—often mistaken for optical augmentation
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with underlying red undertones, weathered but well-kept
physical_description.complexion: Face lined with decades of decision-making; creases around eyes and mouth suggest frequent mild expressions rather than habitual frowning. Skin shows even texture and good care—no visible scarring on the face. Minimal makeup, if any. Expression carries quiet authority.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent vein tracery on left forearm: faint blue-green lines branching from wrist to elbow, pulsing faintly with elevated heart rate (old mod, circa 2190s)
Small scar on right palm, likely from sharp object or industrial accident, partially obscured by subdermal memory chip implant site
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent forearm tracery (active, cosmetic). Subdermal memory chip in right thumb (barely visible—subtle raised scar on thumb pad). Otherwise unaugmented appearance; any other modifications are subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy; never rushed, never wasted motion. Sits solidly, takes up space without apology. Hands are constantly in motion when thinking—shuffling imaginary papers, calculating on fingertips. Her stillness when listening is absolute and unsettling.
physical_description.clothing_style: Heavy linen wraps in ochre, rust, and earth tones—intentionally evocative of West African textile traditions, but in contemporary cuts suitable for Tier 4 Gravesend Basin. Layers that allow concealment of a calculating pad in the folds. Always carries a cup (tea, coffee, warm milk—never empty-handed). Practical footwear, worn but maintained. No visible corporate branding; clothes read as 'community fixture' rather than 'wealthy' or 'struggling.' A single piece of jewelry: a worn silver bracelet that has belonged to her for decades.
